name: @aos/knowledge-analytics
description: AOS Enterprise Knowledge Analytics — the standalone, in-memory analytics, metrics, and reporting engine of the Knowledge Runtime. Aggregates caller-supplied samples (usage, search, retrieval, query, embedding, graph, quality, performance, trend, cost, recommendation) and computes real derived statistics (rates, averages, percentiles, trends) via a shared metric calculator, then assembles the results into ten report types and dashboard snapshots through a six-stage analytics pipeline. Pure domain: no database, no network, no filesystem persistence — everything in-memory. This package imports ZERO other @aos/* packages at runtime; it defines its own exception base class, its own lightweight event-publishing mechanism, and its own module contract so it remains fully standalone.
